purpose: Check whether a shadow index draft is ready to be submitted for manager or human integration without directly modifying manager or formal indexes.

precheck_items.pass_standard: All new assets are inside the video production shadow base.
precheck_items.failure_action: Stop merge and register boundary risk.

precheck_items.pass_standard: Key assets have both md and json files or a clear single-file reason.
precheck_items.failure_action: Complete missing pair or register gap.

precheck_items.pass_standard: JSON files pass local parse check.
Assets are marked W1/R0 or low-risk shadow construction.
No implementation instructions for real model, render, publish, n8n, or WeCom real send.
precheck_items.failure_action: Keep blocker record only and remove implementation wording.

precheck_items.pass_standard: Generation release, real render release, and publishing release stay separate.
precheck_items.failure_action: Split gate records before moving forward.

precheck_items.pass_standard: Next-stage assets carry human review or pending review fields.
Shadow drafts are not described as formal conclusions.
precheck_items.failure_action: Change wording to draft or pending review.
